title: Anki was built for efficiency. What happened?
text:
This redesign is absolutely atrocious. It feels like the developers fundamentally misunderstand why people use Anki in the first place.

Anki is a STUDY TOOL. Its greatest strength has always been efficiency. The old interface was compact, straightforward, and information-dense. I could open the app, immediately see all my decks and their review counts, and get to work. Now everything is buried inside enormous rounded rectangles, unnecessary spacing, oversized menus, and endless scrolling. Information that previously fit on one screen now requires navigating an absurd amount of visual clutter.

Why on earth does every deck need to spell out “New,” “Learning,” and “To Review”? Anyone who has used Anki for more than a day understands what the colored numbers mean. We don’t need the interface holding our hands and wasting half the screen explaining them. Even the supposed compact mode doesn’t adequately address the wasted space.

This honestly looks like someone asked an AI to “make Anki look like a modern iOS app” and implemented the result without considering how people actually use the software. It’s design for the sake of design, with absolutely no regard for workflow efficiency.

I was already concerned when Damien Elmes stepped back from leading Anki’s development. This update has done nothing to inspire confidence in the new direction. Anki became successful because it prioritized FUNCTION over appearance. It was a powerful, practical tool that respected its users’ time. The new developers seem determined to sacrifice those qualities in pursuit of an interface that looks fashionable in screenshots.

I don’t need Anki to look like every other bloated modern app. I need it to help me STUDY. Every extra tap, every unnecessary scroll, and every wasted inch of screen space makes that experience worse.

Stop trying to make Anki pretty. Make it efficient. Give us the original compact interface back, or at the very least a genuine legacy layout option.

This is a massive step backward for one of the best study tools ever created.

The entire point of the old Anki design was to get as much information as possible and as Little space as possible. You guys have taken the exact opposite approach now there’s a bunch of free space everywhere and all of the information is overly verbose and half of it doesn’t even fit. I don’t need verbose information if there’s an entire five minute learning curve to figure out how to use Anki, but that keeps things simpler that’s infinitely better than whatever this. Not only is searching way more difficult because I have to click a bunch of extra buttons just to get the search button to actually do the search, but then when it finally does search, the results are completely useless. You basically end up having to click into each individual card to see if it’s the one you were looking for, I never had this problem with the old design. There is a synchronize button on both versions but this has yet to work for me a single time. I have to have both versions open and in front of me, restart them multiple times, and go into settings to force a one way download each time I want to switch between devices and even with this I sometimes have to do it multiple times before they actually sync with each other. This has become a big annoyance and makes it impossible to be able to study on my phone at any time if I haven’t synced it since I last used my laptop lessening the convenience of having the app on my phone which is the only reason I was willing to pay so much for an app I’d been using for free for so long in the first place.

title: Not worth it. Horrible interface.
text: I’ve spent more time trying to learn how to navigate this app than I have actually studying the material I’m supposed to be learning. I don’t understand how the user interface could be so poorly designed. It’s extremely frustrating. Complete waste of time, complete waste of money. I truly don’t understand how this app is so popular.

title: This app is ruining my motivation to study
text: I have spent hundreds of hours making cards on this app. Earlier today, it wiped out a whole lectures worth of slides. Tonight I get on to use it and it has wiped out hundreds of my cards. Almost all of my decks are now empty. I am absolutely devestated. I have exams tomorrow and all of my study material is gone even tho I spent 25 dollars on this app.

title: Awful complicated nonsense
text: Just allow people to go back to a previous deck with a previous format. Why is this a huge problem? Your “support” forums are useless nonsense too with users answering to absolutely no one with no real answers. No help, no simple solution to simple questions and a ton of options I will never use.

title: Terrible
text: Would not sync with anki web. Confusing clunky, wish I could get a refund
